framings.name: H_FIELDS_V1
framings.preimage: frame(domain) || repeated frame(field), where frame(x) = u64_be(len(x)) || x

framings.name: MERKLE_ROOT_V1
framings.odd_node: promote the final unpaired node unchanged
framings.sorting: caller-owned; the Merkle primitive never sorts, deduplicates, or pads

framings.name: MMR_ROOT_V1
framings.peaks: append each leaf as a height-0 peak, then while the last two peaks have equal height replace them with node(left, right) at height + 1; the shape that results is one peak per set bit of the leaf count, highest on the left, and an implementation may not choose another
framings.fold: right to left: acc = rightmost peak, then acc = node(peak, acc) over the remaining peaks from right to left; one leaf roots to that leaf with no extra node layer
framings.sorting: caller-owned ordering; the leaf index enters the leaf preimage, and the MMR primitive never sorts, deduplicates, or pads

requirements: R and S are non-zero and in scalar range
DER and 65-byte recoverable encodings are rejected
